detail.body:
### What does this PR do?

V1 `separate_async` currently ignores `standalone_gpu_memory_utilization` when creating the standalone rollout manager. Apply the existing override to a copied config so dedicated rollout GPUs can use a different budget while hybrid replicas retain their own setting.

Fixes #7795. This follows the runtime semantics introduced for experimental fully async in #6556. Missing or explicit `null` values retain the fallback to `gpu_memory_utilization`.

### Checklist Before Starting

- [x] Search for similar PRs: [configuration field](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pulls?q=is%3Apr+standalone_gpu_memory_utilization), [issue reference](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pulls?q=is%3Apr+7795+in%3Abody).
- [x] Use the required module/type title format.

Open #7430 adds a broader set of missing rollout YAML keys but does not implement this V1 runtime fix. Following [maintainer feedback](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pull/7926#discussion_r4059130980), this PR also declares this one field in `rollout.yaml` and updates the four generated trainer configs. Other configuration-parity work remains outside this PR.

### Design & Code Changes

- Copy the full config before standalone manager creation, preserving OmegaConf interpolation context and leaving the trainer/hybrid config unchanged.
- Declare `standalone_gpu_memory_utilization: ${oc.select:actor_rollout_ref.rollout.gpu_memory_utilization}` in the default rollout YAML and regenerate the DP, Megatron, VeOmni, and TorchTitan reference configs.
- Cover default inheritance, explicit `null`, and ordinary Hydra overrides across all four model-engine configurations, with hybrid replicas enabled and disabled.
- Remove the unsupported `flush=True` argument from `logger.info` in standalone-only setup; the regression tests exposed the existing TypeError on that path.
- Update the V1 documentation to use an ordinary override without `++`.

### API and Usage Example

```bash
actor_rollout_ref.rollout.gpu_memory_utilization=0.5 \
actor_rollout_ref.rollout.standalone_gpu_memory_utilization=0.85
```

Choose fractions suitable for each GPU pool. The standalone value follows `gpu_memory_utilization` by default. An explicit `null` also falls back to that value. The override applies when `actor_rollout_ref.hybrid_engine=False` too.

### Test

Executed on the remote Linux host with Python 3.12.14 and `PYTHONPATH` unset:

```bash
env -u PYTHONPATH CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES= TORCH_COMPILE_DISABLE=1 TORCHINDUCTOR_DISABLE=1 \
  ../.venv/bin/python -m pytest -s -x --asyncio-mode=auto \
  tests/trainer/ppo/v1/test_separate_async_step_switch_on_cpu.py \
  tests/trainer/ppo/v1/test_trainer_base_on_cpu.py \
  tests/trainer/ppo/v1/test_v1_async_warmup_on_cpu.py \
  tests/trainer/ppo/v1/test_v1_async_alignment_on_cpu.py \
  tests/trainer/ppo/v1/test_rollout_profiling_on_cpu.py
```

- **107 passed**: 67 target tests and 40 adjacent tests.
- The 24 Hydra composition/setup cases all failed before adding the YAML field and pass afterward. They exercise DP, Megatron, VeOmni, and TorchTitan configuration composition, default inheritance, explicit `null`/numeric overrides, and hybrid enable/disable.
- The original runtime regression had 11 failures / 4 passes before the production fix.
- All four generated configs were regenerated with `scripts/generate_trainer_config.sh`; a second run passed without further changes.
- All 14 equivalent local pre-commit hooks passed with Ruff 0.12.2 and mypy 1.17.0; generated-config verification was included. The original isolated hook installation again exceeded a 60-second limit before hooks started, so this does not claim the original isolated pre-commit run passed.

The setup tests invoke the actual V1 `_setup` while mocking expensive base setup, LLM server creation, and checkpoint manager construction. They test configuration behavior, not execution of the four training engines. Existing CPU CI collects this `*_on_cpu.py` file.

The remote tests use the prepared environment, not the complete frozen CI environment: an earlier `uv run --frozen --all-packages --extra cpu` bootstrap timed out during downloads. A previous broader V1 directory run reached 36 passes before Ray/TransferQueue fixture initialization failed to create worker threads. No real multi-GPU hybrid/standalone vLLM/SGLang end-to-end job or performance measurement was run.

### Checklist Before Submitting

- [x] Read the contribution guide and agent instructions.
- [x] Update the V1 async trainer documentation and generated configs.
- [x] Add tests collected by the existing CPU CI workflow.
- [x] Human submitter confirmed review of the initial change and explicitly requested this review follow-up.
- [ ] Human submitter personally ran relevant tests; the results above were executed with AI assistance.
- Recipe submodule: not applicable.

AI assistance was used for investigation, implementation, documentation, and test execution. The submitting contributor remains accountable for the contribution.

@@ -1,6 +1,6 @@
 # V1 Async Trainer
 
-Last updated: 09/16/2026.
+Last updated: 09/21/2026.
 
 The V1 trainer provides two asynchronous PPO training modes under the standard `verl.trainer.main_ppo` entry point:
 
@@ -215,6 +215,15 @@ trainer.v1.separate_async.num_warmup_batches=1
 
 `num_warmup_batches` also accepts fractional values (see [colocate async](#colocate-async)).
 
+Hybrid replicas use `actor_rollout_ref.rollout.gpu_memory_utilization`. To give dedicated standalone rollout GPUs a different memory budget, set the existing `standalone_gpu_memory_utilization` override:
+
+```bash
+actor_rollout_ref.rollout.gpu_memory_utilization=0.5 \
+actor_rollout_ref.rollout.standalone_gpu_memory_utilization=0.85
+```
+
+Choose both fractions for the memory available on their respective GPU pools. By default, `standalone_gpu_memory_utilization` follows `gpu_memory_utilization`. Setting it to `null` also falls back to `gpu_memory_utilization`. The override also applies when `actor_rollout_ref.hybrid_engine=False`, and does not change the trainer's or hybrid replicas' configuration.
+
 `separate_async` requires a non-`naive` checkpoint-engine backend such as `nccl`, `nixl`, or `mooncake` for standalone rollout weight synchronization.
 
 To enable step switching, add:

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("hybrid_enabled", [True, False])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("standalone_memory", ["missing", None, 0.85])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("interpolated", [False, True])
+def test_setup_standalone_memory_budget(monkeypatch, hybrid_enabled, standalone_memory, interpolated):
+    trainer, created_configs, checkpoint_calls = _memory_budget_setup(
+        monkeypatch, hybrid_enabled, standalone_memory, interpolated=interpolated
+    )
+    original = OmegaConf.to_container(trainer.config, resolve=False)
+
+    trainer._setup()

+    standalone_config, start_rank = created_configs[0]
+    expected = 0.85 if standalone_memory == 0.85 else 0.45
+    assert standalone_config.actor_rollout_ref.rollout.gpu_memory_utilization == expected
+    assert trainer.hybrid_config.actor_rollout_ref.rollout.gpu_memory_utilization == 0.45
+    assert OmegaConf.to_container(trainer.config, resolve=False) == original
+    assert start_rank == (2 if hybrid_enabled else 0)
+    assert checkpoint_calls[0]["replicas"] == ["standalone"]
+    assert checkpoint_calls[0]["actor_wg"] is trainer.actor_rollout_wg
+    assert trainer.current_mode == (HybridEngineMode.ROLLOUT if hybrid_enabled else HybridEngineMode.TRAINER)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("hybrid_enabled", [True, False])
+def test_setup_standalone_memory_failure_preserves_config(monkeypatch, hybrid_enabled):
+    trainer, created_configs, checkpoint_calls = _memory_budget_setup(monkeypatch, hybrid_enabled, 0.85, fail_init=True)
+    original = OmegaConf.to_container(trainer.config, resolve=False)
+
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="standalone init failed"):
+        trainer._setup()
+
+    assert created_configs[0][0].actor_rollout_ref.rollout.gpu_memory_utilization == 0.85
+    assert OmegaConf.to_container(trainer.config, resolve=False) == original
+    assert trainer.hybrid_config.actor_rollout_ref.rollout.gpu_memory_utilization == 0.45
+    assert checkpoint_calls == []
+
+
+def _memory_budget_setup(monkeypatch, hybrid_enabled, standalone_memory, *, interpolated=False, fail_init=False):
+    trainer = object.__new__(PPOTrainerSeparateAsync)
+    trainer._enable_hybrid_replicas = hybrid_enabled
+    trainer.config = OmegaConf.create(
+        {
+            "memory": {"hybrid": 0.45, "standalone": 0.85},
+            "actor_rollout_ref": {
+                "rollout": {
+                    "gpu_memory_utilization": "${memory.hybrid}" if interpolated else 0.45,
+                    "name": "vllm",
+                    "prometheus": {"enable": False},
+                    "checkpoint_engine": {
+                        "_target_": "verl.workers.config.CheckpointEngineConfig",
+                        "backend": "nccl",
+                    },
+                }
+            },
+        }
+    )
+    if standalone_memory != "missing":
+        trainer.config.actor_rollout_ref.rollout.standalone_gpu_memory_utilization = (
+            "${memory.standalone}" if interpolated and standalone_memory is not None else standalone_memory
+        )
+    OmegaConf.set_struct(trainer.config, True)
+    created_configs = []
+    checkpoint_calls = []
+
+    def base_setup(self):
+        self.hybrid_config = self.config
+        self.actor_rollout_wg = object()
+        self.llm_server_manager = SimpleNamespace(rollout_replicas=[0, 1] if hybrid_enabled else [])
+
+    def create_standalone(*, config, start_rank):
+        created_configs.append((config, start_rank))
+        if fail_init:
+            raise RuntimeError("standalone init failed")
+        return SimpleNamespace(get_replicas=lambda: ["standalone"])
+
+    def create_checkpoint_manager(**kwargs):
+        checkpoint_calls.append(kwargs)
+        return object()
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(trainer_module.PPOTrainer, "_setup", base_setup)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(trainer_module.LLMServerManager, "create", create_standalone)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(trainer_module, "CheckpointEngineManager", create_checkpoint_manager)
+    trainer.add_replicas_to_balancer = lambda: None
+    return trainer, created_configs, checkpoint_calls
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("model_engine", ["dp", "megatron", "veomni", "torchtitan"])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("hybrid_enabled", [True, False])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("standalone_memory", ["default", "null", "0.85"])
+def test_setup_standalone_memory_from_hydra_override(monkeypatch, model_engine, hybrid_enabled, standalone_memory):
+    trainer, created_configs, _ = _memory_budget_setup(monkeypatch, hybrid_enabled, None)
+    overrides = [
+        f"model_engine={model_engine}",
+        f"actor_rollout_ref.hybrid_engine={hybrid_enabled}",
+        "actor_rollout_ref.rollout.gpu_memory_utilization=0.45",
+    ]
+    if standalone_memory != "default":
+        overrides.append(f"actor_rollout_ref.rollout.standalone_gpu_memory_utilization={standalone_memory}")
+    with initialize_config_module(config_module="verl.trainer.config", version_base=None):
+        trainer.config = compose(config_name="ppo_trainer", overrides=overrides)
+
+    expected = 0.85 if standalone_memory == "0.85" else 0.45
+    assert trainer.config.actor_rollout_ref.rollout.standalone_gpu_memory_utilization == (
+        None if standalone_memory == "null" else expected
+    )
+    original = OmegaConf.to_container(trainer.config, resolve=False)
+
+    trainer._setup()
+
+    assert created_configs[0][0].actor_rollout_ref.rollout.gpu_memory_utilization == expected
+    assert trainer.config.actor_rollout_ref.rollout.gpu_memory_utilization == 0.45
+    assert OmegaConf.to_container(trainer.config, resolve=False) == original
